subject: Post-call: Finovate trial success criteria, infra owners & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam T. <sam.t@finovate.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps: Finovate trial (success criteria + owners)

Hi Sam — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed owners so we can get the trial standing up this week. Please correct anything I missed.

High-level trial objective
- 4-week evaluation to validate inference latency & cost for your peak workflow (customer-facing recommendation service).

Success criteria (what Finovate will measure)
- 95th pct token latency < 180ms for 512-token requests under 50r/s load
- End-to-end per-request cost below $0.012 at target throughput
- No PII persistence: KB TTL and KV-cache behavior validated
- Integration smoke tests: embeddings + rerank working against your ranking pipeline

Proposed owner map (please confirm)
- Infra / network: Marissa Cole (VPC peering, firewall/IP allowlist, test VM access)
- App / integration: Stephanie Nguyen (integration hooks, sample traffic, smoke tests)
- Security & compliance liaison: Aditya Rao (SOC2 evidence, DPA questions, data handling)
- Commercial / procurement: Grace O'Connor (pricing, SOW, signatures)

Immediate next steps (action-by + ETA)
- Marissa: provide IPs and target test subnet for allowlist (ETA: 2027-04-12) — see attached network-access-template.txt
- Stephanie: push a small sample workload (5–10k tokens) and share logs in Drive link (ETA: 2027-04-13)
- Aditya: share SOC2 cert + DPA draft with procurement contacts (ETA: 2027-04-08)
- Grace: send SOW + DocuSign link and draft pricing for 4-week trial (on me, by 2027-04-06)

Attachments: finovate-trial-mop-v1.pdf (trial plan), network-access-template.txt

Meeting cadence: weekly 30-min sync (Tuesdays) — propose first checkpoint 2027-04-13.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up with your infra/security folks if helpful.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Sam T. <sam.t@finovate.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Liao <jared.liao@finovate.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps: Finovate trial (success criteria + owners)

Grace — thanks for the concise note and owners map. All looks good from our side. A couple clarifications:

- Timeline: 4-week window works; we'd like the trial to start the week of 2027-04-19 to align with an internal sprint.
- Security: SOC2 and DPA required; we also need to validate that logs are not retained beyond the test window.
- Data residency: production would be US-only; trial can be in a Redwood-hosted region in us-west.

Procurement will handle the PO and contract redlines. Please send the DPA + SOC2 evidence to procurement@finovate.com. Jared is our infra lead and will coordinate the allowlist and smoke test traffic.

One more ask: can you confirm fallback behaviour if a model variant is unavailable (we want an automatic fallback to a cheaper, slightly-larger-latency model rather than failure)?

Sam
Sam T.
Head of Platform Engineering | Finovate
sam.t@finovate.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: confirming owners + what we need from engineering/security

Folks — looping to confirm the ownership breakdown and what we need to unblock the trial. Short RACI-style notes below (R = responsible, A = accountable, C = consulted, I = informed):

- Infra (VPC peering, IP allowlist, test VM): R=Marissa, A=Marissa, C=Jared (Finovate), I=Grace
- Integration (sample traffic, smoke tests, metrics ingestion): R=Stephanie, A=Stephanie, C=Marissa, I=Grace
- Security/compliance (SOC2, DPA, data retention config): R=Aditya (liaison), A=Aditya, C=Marissa, I=Grace
- Commercial (SOW, pricing, DocuSign): R=Grace, A=Grace, I=All

What I need from Marissa this week:
- Confirm whether Finovate will use VPC peering or IP allowlist (we can support both)
- Provide the CIDR/subnet and a contact email for firewall rules (we'll add to the network template)

Stephanie — can you prepare the smoke-test payloads and one endpoint spec (sample curl + headers) so Jared can route traffic into the job? If you want, I can draft the smoke test runner in a short script.

Grace — I'll start compiling a minimal SOC2 evidence pack (SOC2 type II summary + control owner list) and will send the DPA stub by EOD 2027-04-08.

-Aditya
From: Lisa Chou <procurement@finovate.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Finovate procurement: SOW, DPA, and payment terms

Hi Grace / Aditya — I'm handling the procurement side. Per our policy please provide the following before we can issue a PO:

1) Master SOW for the 4-week trial (including performance acceptance criteria)
2) DPA and SOC2 summary (we do not accept links-only; please attach PDFs)
3) Pricing quote with trial terms and post-trial options (30-day net preferred)
4) DocuSign link for signature — we need a corporate signatory and billing contact

We typically process trials within two business days after receiving the SOW + DPA. If you have standard terms/discounts for trials that may convert, note them in the SOW.

Please send materials to procurement@finovate.com. If you prefer, we can take the DPA redline via DocuSign too.

Best,
Lisa Chou
Procurement Manager | Finovate
procurement@finovate.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam T. <sam.t@finovate.com>, Lisa Chou <procurement@finovate.com>, Jared Liao <jared.liao@finovate.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Finovate trial: final plan, owners, and next meeting (action required)

Thanks all — summary and updated commitments below. Please treat this as the single source of truth for next steps.

Confirmed trial window: 2027-04-19 through 2027-05-16 (4 weeks).

Assignments (final):
- Infra / network owner: Marissa Cole — deliver IP allowlist or peering details (due 2027-04-12)
- App / integration owner: Stephanie Nguyen — share sample payloads + endpoint spec (due 2027-04-13)
- Security / compliance liaison: Aditya Rao — send SOC2 pack and DPA stub (due 2027-04-08)
- Procurement contact (Finovate): Lisa Chou / procurement@finovate.com
- Commercial lead (Redwood): Grace O'Connor — SOW & DocuSign sent (attached link)

Links / attachments: SOW draft (DocuSign link) - https://docusign.com/link/rdw-ftv-2027-0083
Drive: https://drive.google.com/finovate-trial-success-criteria
Network template attached: network-access-template.txt

Open items for Finovate: confirm fallback model behavior (Sam); confirm PO terms (Lisa / procurement).

Next meeting: Kickoff 2027-04-19 09:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.

If no objections, I'll send the SOW + DocuSign this afternoon.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
